correctness.rationale: For PG(2,F3), independently generated 13 normalized points, 13 four-point lines and all 52 collinear triples. Exhaustive 8191-subset filtration gives f=(13,78,234,234), 559 nonempty faces and no 5-arcs. Reconstructed vertex-toggle matching has 242 pairs, 1 critical vertex, 4 critical 2-cells, 70 critical 3-cells; directed Hasse graph topologically sorts all 559 faces. Independently generated integral 4-by-70 Morse differential has Smith factors (1,3,3,3). A CW complex with no 1-cells and an S2-wedge two-skeleton admits only degree vectors for 3-cell attachments; elementary integer basis changes give 66 S3 and three M(Z/3,2), not just homology.

originality.rationale: Distinct from the projective-plane line-facet incidence complexes of Cook et al and Superdock. Those complexes use lines or two copies of line arrangements; neither makes 234 four-point arcs its facets. Resultary same-plane nonincidence neighborhood complexes and finite-geometry torsion examples have distinct functors. No implication-equivalent whole homotopy decomposition identified after targeted searches and primary section reading; unindexed cap-complex sources and older books remain priority risks.
